title: Procurement SOP
content: Procurement Standard Operating Procedure (Confidential). Purchases above RM 10,000 require three written quotations and approval from the Head of Procurement. Vendors must be registered in the approved vendor list before a purchase order is issued. Single-source purchases above RM 50,000 require written justification signed by the Chief Financial Officer.

title: Travel Policy
content: Travel Policy. Employees must book economy class for flights under six hours.

title: Leave Policy
content: Leave Policy (Public, Human Resources). Staff are entitled to 14 days of annual leave in their first two years of service, rising to 18 days after two years. Unused annual leave of up to 5 days may be carried forward to the next calendar year.

title: Zentrix Pricing Agreement
content: Confidential Vendor Pricing Agreement. The negotiated unit price for steel fasteners from Zentrix Industrial Supplies is RM 4.75 per unit, valid until 31 March 2027. The rebate threshold is 250,000 units per year, above which a 6 percent rebate applies.

title: Fleet Maintenance Manual
content: Fleet Maintenance Manual. Trucks are serviced every 15,000 kilometres. Drivers report brake faults to the depot supervisor within 24 hours.
